name: Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory Single-Player
summary: Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory Single-Player aims to recreate the cut single-player campaign of Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory – the missing link of the classic Wolfenstein series – in the form of a story-driven single-player conversion of Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory's maps.
